name: Combinatorial Property Masking
description: Replaces the geometric constraint (circles externally tangent trivially implies sum of radii is 3) with a combinatorial constraint: a $c_u \times c_v$ grid must have exactly 3 subrectangles. This evaluates to true only for $\{1, 2\}$ and $\{2, 1\}$, preserving the bipartite constraint exactly, but forces models to manually evaluate the 4 finite cases to discover the $c_u \neq c_v$ relationship, breaking pattern-matching.
